caption: The drawing depicts an arched decorative grille, rendered primarily in brown ink on a light beige background. The arch consists of a thick outer border enclosing a pattern of nested circles that form a ring along the curved perimeter and down the two vertical sides. Inside the arch, there is a symmetrical design with six large C-shaped scrolls radiating from a central flower-like element. From the center, six straight lines extend outward, bisecting the space between each scroll. The overall composition is balanced with repeated circular and curved motifs, with the detailed central flower at the intersection of all internal structures. The artwork is neatly framed within the boundaries of the arched shape. At the bottom center of the paper, faint cursive writing is visible.
title: Arch Grill
